title: 18.6K Impressions, 1.3K Clicks, 143 Conversions — My Google Ads Results
author: EnvironmentalPart750
selftext:
I’m posting this in case anyone is considering using Google Ads for their mobile game and is curious about what kind of results they might get.

I’ve been testing Google Ads for my indie mobile game, targeting India. Here are the results so far:

**18.6K impressions**  
**1.3K clicks**  
**6.99% CTR**  
**143 conversions**  
**\~$0.007 avg. CPC**

Still testing and learning. How do these numbers look to you?

here is the game if you want to try

  
[Odyssey Arena Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cukkacreatives.herorivals)

comments.author: Fit_Skirt2922
comments.body: Looks actually super viable, thanks. However, what actually is "conversion" in your case? Game install on mobile?

replies.author: EnvironmentalPart750
replies.body: Yes it's game installs, it's about 30-40 for 2  usd

comments.author: Fit_Skirt2922
comments.body: Also, what is the format and your creative?

replies.author: EnvironmentalPart750
replies.body:
I skipped for all assets. I heard that if you skip adding assets, you force Google ads to show your ads only on play store recommended section, it's how I wanted.

So i didn't add any assets,only a headline and description, i am guessing i am being shown on recommended section.
